body:
The card modal now omits visible section names and heading counts while retaining accessible headings and layout-menu labels. Add counter remains right-aligned; the visible gesture helper is removed. Archived is a short right-aligned toggle with an exposed pressed state. Schedule keeps its relative summary when expanded. Existing editing and counter behavior are preserved.

Full gate: 251 Rust, 137 JavaScript and 12 Python tests pass, plus six release Chromium and four WebKit suites. Visual/geometry checks cover 320–1440px, tablet, landscape, both themes and the archive toggle. Rebuilt/restarted the existing manual app: trusted HTTPS at https://100.122.250.14:47832 serves 33 matching build assets; all 35 prior resource versions, two pins, preferences and certificate are preserved.

Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-minimal-card-sections.md. Physical-device and full release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: Minimize card section headings and counter actions
